validation.rule: Select coarsest decay grid whose paired NLL upper bound is <=0.02 versus state_fp8 and exact; qualify replay independently versus exact. State FP8 must pass versus exact. Do not access test until selection is frozen. Qualify INT8 state and INT8-anchor replay separately against exact and their matching FP8 controls with the same 0.02 paired NLL upper bound.

held_out.modes: exact, state_fp8 if eligible, selected decay if eligible, replay if eligible, INT8 state/replay if individually eligible
held_out.rule: Run matched attention-only QAT pilots. Report before/after paired NLL deltas, intervals, finite gradients and updates; a passing pilot does not establish broad quality recovery.

fallback: Keep exact default; explicitly report failed gates. Do not tune on test.

integration.failed_policy_smoke: One attention-only training step and four validation blocks for any family excluded by screening; report solely as gradient/update integration, never recovery or held-out qualification.
